Plans and pricing

Tidewater CI builds, tests and ships your code from the same pipeline file, on our runners or on yours.

Prices are loaded at runtime; contact sales for a quote.

What every plan includes

Pipelines as code.
One file in the repository describes build, test and release.
Shared caches.
Dependencies are restored between branches and purged on demand.
Scoped secrets.
Secrets are encrypted and visible only to the environment that owns them.
Merge gates.
A change lands only when the checks you choose are green.
Preview sites.
Every merge request gets an address where reviewers can try it.
Command line client.
The same commands on Linux, macOS and Windows.
Templates.
Reuse a pipeline across projects and update it in one place.
Visual editor.
See the stages as a graph and edit them without leaving the browser.
Notifications.
Chat, mail and webhooks, with rules per branch.
Insights.
Duration, queue time and flaky tests, per pipeline and per week.
